name: Copper Pancake Calcification
source: Follow the wacky misadventures of the abused Yung Yui and the midlife crisis deity Anubiznis! It's like a pot of oranges falling down a Norwegian hillside allover again, remember your youth!
translation: 跟随受虐待的容锐和中年危机之神阿努比尼斯的古怪不幸经历！就像一盆橘子又从挪威的山坡上掉下来一样，记住你的青春！
